ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity region at the median notch vertex; diffuse light-intensity mottling on the proximal and medial left lobe; right lobe is characterized by largely uniform low-intensity pixel mapping.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 145 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with small-scale serrations on the left lobe; right trailing edge contains a distinct high-amplitude irregular indentation/gap approximately one-third the distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit dorsolateral sweep with convex leading edges and distal tips curving sharply upward; trailing edges exhibit a generally concave profile relative to the notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, circular high-contrast pixel clusters visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of vertical, parallel low-contrast linear pixel streaks on the central portion of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation/trauma on the trailing edge of the right lobe; vertical linear rake-mark scarring on the right lobe surface.
